Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We're looking for a

(Senior) Configuration & Automation Specialist (Microsoft Dynamics Focus) (m/f/d)

(permanent, full-time) to join our Automation & Configuration Team at one of our locations in Berlin, Verl, or Baden-Baden, with flexible working conditions available.

In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of Riverty’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center platform.

As the Dynamics specialist within our Automation & Configuration Team, you will translate business requirements into scalable platform configurations while balancing operational stability with continuous feature delivery. Working closely with Product Owners, Operations, Automation Engineers, Central IT, and external partners, you will help build reliable, maintainable, and future-oriented customer service solutions using a configuration-first approach.

Your Responsibilities

- Configure, maintain, and optimize Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center capabilities
- Design and manage case management, queues, routing rules, workstreams, SLAs, business rules, forms, views, and agent experiences
- Maintain and improve omnichannel customer service capabilities across voice, chat, and email channels
- Own daily operational platform support, including complex configuration issues and second-level troubleshooting
- Translate business requirements into scalable Dynamics configurations and support solution design activities
- Configure and deliver new features, process improvements, and country rollouts from development through production readiness
- Collaborate on automation initiatives using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate
- Support integration testing and change activities together with Automation Engineers and Central IT
- Create and maintain documentation, configuration standards, runbooks, and best practices

Qualifications

Your Qualifications

- Experience configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365, ideally within Customer Service, Contact Center, or similar CRM environments
- Experience with customer service processes such as case management, routing, queues, SLAs, and agent workflows
- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable platform configurations
- Strong problem-solving skills and experience troubleshooting platform-related issues
- Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented way of working
- Professional communication skills in English and German

Nice to Have

- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center or Omnichannel for Customer Service
- Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or similar low-code technologies
- Basic understanding of integrations, APIs, and connected enterprise systems
- Microsoft certifications or equivalent practical experience

What Makes You Successful

- You take ownership of both platform stability and continuous improvement
- You prefer configuration-first solutions over unnecessary custom development
- You enjoy collaborating across Product, Operations, Engineering, and IT teams
- You actively share knowledge and contribute to team growth and cross-skilling initiatives

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here (https://bertelsmann-hr.de/docs/Overview_of_Data_Retention_Periods_EN.pdf) .

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here (https://jobsearch.createyourowncareer.com/content/Privacy-Policy/?locale=en_US) .

Shape the future of flight and apply now online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) with your CV and all relevant certificates / licences!

Part-time 50 % (20 h/week) to start, option to move to full-time after 6 months · permanent · start as soon as possible · English-speaking role

We help people pipette light. Our optoWELL is a programmable LED illumination platform for 24- and 96-well plates, used by labs worldwide in optogenetics, photopharmacology and photodynamic therapy. We are a small team in Freiburg and sell directly to scientists around the globe. To grow, we need one more person who wants to leave the bench and create a lasting role in our startup with us.

What you will own

- Finding researchers who work with light
- Turning them into qualified leads
- Reaching out, following up, and handing warm conversations over to our CEO
- Keeping the pipeline clean and reporting on it
- A smaller share of routine sales admin (quotes, order confirmations, invoices)

You will not be an assistant. You get a clearly defined area, your own numbers, a documented process to start from – and the freedom to improve it.

What you bring

- Some background in light-based research – or the curiosity to dive into it with us; it is a small, friendly field and we will show you around
- A Master's degree or PhD in biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacy, chemistry or a related field – you can read a paper and pull out what matters
- Excellent written English; German is helpful for day-to-day work but not required
- You enjoy writing short, personal messages and are not discouraged by the fact that most people don't reply
- Structured, self-reliant work over weeks with a weekly check-in rather than daily supervision; solid Excel skills
- Nice to have: experience with CRM tools or AI-assisted literature work

What we offer

- A proven, documented sales process that already works – you copy it first, then improve it and make it your own if you can
- A role built around one measurable outcome – conversations booked with qualified scientists – rather than a to-do list
- Direct work with the founder, short decision paths, real insight into how a scientific instrument is sold worldwide
- Flexible hours, remote days possible after onboarding, office at the Freiburg Innovation Center (FRIZ)
- €42,000–50,000 gross per year at full-time equivalent, depending on experience – i.e. €21,000–25,000 for the 50 % start; the same rate applies if the role grows to full-time

What we are really looking for

Someone who is curious about other people's science and would rather understand a lab's actual problem than pitch a product. Someone who works on their own steam, says so when something is not working, and treats scientists and colleagues with the same respect. If that sounds like you, this is not a side role – it is a seat at the core of a small team.

How this works

You will work directly with me, Kathrin – co-founder, CEO, and so far the one doing this job. Send me an email with your CV and two or three sentences on why you want to leave the bench (no cover letter please, and no multi-page AI slop): k.brenker@optobiolabs.com. Then it is simple: a short conversation, a paid two- to three-hour trial task so we both see what the job actually feels like, and fast feedback – you will hear from me within a week, either way.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as the Team Lead for Nuclear Controls Product Management (f/m/d), where you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our Nuclear Instrumentation & Control (I&C) product portfolio. You will lead the strategic direction, ensuring commercial success and regulatory compliance for critical infrastructure applications. Imagine driving product strategy and roadmap decisions while acting as the key interface between customers, engineering, quality, operations, sales, and regulatory stakeholders. Your leadership will guide the product lifecycle management process, ensuring that our offerings meet the highest standards of safety and quality throughout their lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute the global product strategy for the Nuclear Controls portfolio, securing an annual business volume of 100 million Euros
* Manage long-term product lifecycles, aligning with both new-build projects and multi-decade service commitments
* Drive product roadmap decisions, balancing standard product development with project-specific customization needs
* Oversee compliance with stringent international nuclear standards, licensing requirements, and safety-critical certification processes
* Navigate complex regulatory frameworks to ensure all product lines maintain necessary qualifications for global deployment
* Provide continuous strategic support and requirement engineering for key nuclear customers, fostering long-term partnerships

What You Bring

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive professional experience in Product Management or Engineering within the nuclear industry or other highly regulated, safety-critical environments, including responsibility for large-scale product portfolios
* Proven leadership and management experience in senior roles, with a track record of leading cross-functional teams in an international environment
* Professional certifications in Product and/or Project Management, such as Certified Product Manager (AIPMM) or Project Management Professional (PMP), considered an asset
* Expertise in Product Management and Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and the nuclear industry domain
* Strong strategic decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities, combined with business-fluent English and German language skills; French language skills are advantageous

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

In this role, you will drive the introduction of this new capability based on a clear view of customer missions, capability needs, procurement pathways, and operational constraints.
You will build and own ERC's relationships with the Armed Forces of Germany, NATO partners, and global allies. Combining strategic market development, hands-on key account ownership, and capture execution, you will turn operational needs into qualified opportunities, test and evaluation projects, and contracts. In pursuing your mission, you will be working closely with our Commercial Leadership as well as Product, Engineering, Flight Operations, and Communications.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Develop account and market-entry plans for Germany and selected NATO/allied markets
• Build, maintain, and expand durable relationships with military users, capability planners, procurement stakeholders, prime contractors, and operational units
• Identify and qualify defence opportunities ahead of formal tenders; maintain account plans, develop opportunity-specific capture plans, and set pipeline priorities
• Drive opportunities from initial engagement to contract signature, including customer briefings, requirement shaping, proposal development, offer coordination, negotiations, and follow-up
• Navigate military procurement processes and coordinate complex stakeholder landscapes across end users, requirements owners, procurement bodies, industry partners, and internal teams
• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Flight Operations, and Leadership to translate operational needs into mission concepts, demonstration narratives, product requirements, and commercially viable solutions

• Approximately 5 years of experience in business development, key account management, or sales, ideally in the defence or governmental sector or in complex B2B enterprise sales
• A proven record of developing and closing complex opportunities with military, governmental, defence-industry, or enterprise customers
• Strong commercial judgement and the ability to combine account strategy with hands-on project execution
• Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and negotiation skills, including with senior military, governmental, and industrial counterparts in English and German
• A strong understanding of the German defence ecosystem and acquisition pathways
• A structured and ownership-oriented working style

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• bring an active network among military users, requirements owners, and procurement stakeholders

• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location: Dreieich / Remote, Germany. Territory: Southern Germany (Bavaria and Baden Wuertemberg).
Travel: Approximately 50%.

Discover Impactful Work
We are looking for an Account Manager (m/f/d), Materials & Surface Analysis to drive profitable growth across assigned customers and markets in Southern Germany.

This is a highly dynamic sales role with strong connections to technical, marketing, service and other commercial functions. You will develop strategic customer relationships, understand customer priorities and position Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions to address their scientific and business needs.

The portfolio includes Electron Microscopy (EM), X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), software, services and related analytical workflows. These core technologies are complemented by adjacent techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD), Raman Spectroscopy, Ion Scattering Spectroscopy (ISS), Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS), and others.

A Day in the Life:
You will thrive in this role if you enjoy working in a multidisciplinary, highly technical environment where collaboration, customer engagement and continuous personal development are essential to success.

As part of our Sales and Service organization, you will identify and understand customer needs, develop your market and use your technical expertise and product knowledge to build effective sales strategies. You will create customer presentations, respond to tenders, recommend suitable product solutions and drive opportunities through to successful closure.

Using your technical knowledge and strong interpersonal skills, you will engage effectively with both prospective and existing customers. You will own the full sales cycle—from lead generation and opportunity development through negotiation and closure.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with a broad network of colleagues, including our NanoPort demonstration facilities, product specialists, marketing professionals, fellow Account Managers, service teams and other business functions.

What to expect:

- Develop and strengthen strategic relationships with assigned customers and markets.
- Understand customer priorities and position Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions to create measurable value.
- Own and manage the complete sales cycle from lead identification through closure.
- Identify customer needs, market trends and new business opportunities.
- Apply technical expertise and product knowledge to develop effective sales strategies.
- Prepare and deliver compelling customer presentations and commercial proposals.
- Respond to tenders and recommend the most appropriate product and workflow solutions.
- Build and maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline and accurate sales forecast.
- Collaborate closely with NanoPort colleagues, product specialists, marketing, service teams, peer Account Managers and other business functions.
- Maintain strong CRM and commercial discipline throughout the sales process.
- Travel approximately 50% within the assigned territory.

Keys to Success:
Education

- Typically, an M.Sc. degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics or a related scientific or technical field.

Experience

- Demonstrated familiarity with XPS, electron microscopy, spectroscopy, imaging or related analytical instrumentation is required.
- Previous client-facing commercial experience is required.
- Experience working successfully within a matrix organization, with responsibility for clear and effective communication across teams, is highly valuable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Business-fluent German is required.
- Business-fluent English is required.
- Additional languages are welcome but not essential.
- Proactive, self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership.
- Strong interpersonal skills and an openness to working across cultures and diverse teams.
- Confident communicator in customer meetings, presentations and public-speaking settings.
- Clear, open and effective communication style.
- Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external customer relationships.
- Ability to articulate how our technologies support materials science applications and create value for customers.
- Strong ability to prioritize requirements and meet or exceed customer expectations.
- Commitment to continuously developing commercial skills and improving sales processes.
- Strong CRM discipline and willingness to work within established business processes.

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

The Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE) in
Garching (near Munich), Germany, is a world-leading institute for
developing and operating state-of-the-art astronomical instruments.
Over the past years, MPE has taken a leading role in the development
of instrumentation for several international space- and ground-based
projects, for example XMM-Newton, Herschel, SRG/eROSITA, EUCLID, the
VLT telescopes (e.g. KMOS, GRAVITY) and Einstein Probe. The MPE
High-Energy group, led by Prof. K. Nandra, carries out major space
hardware programs including the development of X-ray detectors and
X-ray optics in support of its astrophysics research program. Within
the framework of ESA’s future large-class space mission New Athena,
MPE leads the international consortium developing the Wide Field
Imager (WFI), one of the two instruments aboard the X-ray satellite.
Further details about the WFI, which is based on the Max Planck
Society’s unique Silicon DEPFET technology, can be found here:
https://www.mpe.mpg.de/ATHENA-WFI/ The MPE High Energy group is
seeking an experienced Lead System Engineer for the WFI project, who

allocation and management of technical budgets/​tolerances.

with schedule development and resource planning, and monitor
engineering progress against the project schedule, coordinating the
technical actions needed to support timely achievement of engineering
milestones. Your Qualifications: Essential: A completed scientific
university degree (M.Sc. or Dipl.‑Ing.) in engineering or an
equivalent qualification with in‑depth knowledge of scientific
instrumentation development. A physics degree with applicable work

Desirable: Given that electronics is the technical core of the
